name: Sticky MicroNotes
summary: Distraction-free notes on Sticky with a BLE keyboard and Wi-Fi file transfer.
description: Sticky MicroNotes is a writing firmware for the reTerminal Sticky. Pair a Bluetooth LE keyboard, type notes, save them to microSD, manage .txt files from a phone or laptop at http://sticky.local. Touch bar navigation, gyro auto-rotate and a clean sleep page that can keep the current note on screen.

compatibility.notes: Tested on Seeed reTerminal Sticky (ESP32-S3R8, 800x480 SSD1677, GT911 touch). Requires a microSD + BLE keyboard.

assets.previewAlt: Sticky MicroNotes home menu on reTerminal Sticky

notes.title: Device flashing
notes.description: Connect your reTerminal Sticky with a USB data cable and use desktop Chrome, Firefox or Edge +your preferred esp32 flasher

notes.title: Installation
notes.description: This package writes a full Sticky image from flash offset 0 (bootloader, partition table, and app). Use DIO 40 MHz.

notes.title: After flashing
notes.description: Insert a microSD card, pair a BLE keyboard, join a 2.4GHz Wi-Fi network, write some notes, manage notes at http://sticky.local (on the same network)
